get_prompts_list: get all prompts accessible to the authenticated user with optional admin bypass
create_new_prompt: create a new prompt with a command key, title, and content stored in the database
get_prompt_by_command: retrieve a single prompt by its command identifier with read access control checks
update_prompt_by_command: update an existing prompt's title, content, and command by its command identifier
delete_prompt_by_command: delete a prompt by its command identifier after verifying write access permissions
